claim_boundary: HACS v1.1.1 contributes BSD-licensed annotation metadata for real public-video fencing intervals. The 1,458 dense segments and 5,690 positive sparse clips overlap, so only the merged 6,457 intervals across 2,243 source videos and 9.589 hours may be used as a union total. Thirteen dense segments exceed the upstream reported source duration by some positive amount; eight exceed it by more than 0.05 seconds (0.06-0.55 seconds). Original timestamps are retained and flagged rather than silently clipped. The linked media are not downloaded or represented as reusable, and HACS does not label weapon, athlete, touch, or bout.
grouping_rule: hold out complete source_group_id values (one YouTube video)
media_license_status: linked YouTube media rights are not asserted by HACS
